post.summary: Take a pending steer back (Edit, Cancel) before the Agent takes it.
Deliver a pending steer now instead of after the running tools.
Ephemeral side question answered in a hidden session that inherits the transcript.

get.summary: Server settings plus auth-state, max_tokens, and version badges.

post.summary: Save settings; `_set_password`, `_clear_password`, `_passwordless`, `_current_password`, and `max_tokens` are handled specially.
Per-client switch: sets the profile cookie; never mutates the process-wide profile.
Evict the live model cache for one provider (or all when omitted) and answer the rebuilt catalog.

scope=main sets config.yaml model.default; scope=auxiliary assigns one task slot (`__reset__` clears all) and answers the refreshed auxiliary state. An auxiliary `model` may be a `/api/models` entry id; provider `auto` with an empty model clears the override.
Write (or clear when api_key is empty) a provider API key in the profile .env.
Body is `{display: show|hide}` or `{effort, model?, provider?, base_url?}`.
Browser OAuth flows are not available in this release (501).

get.summary: Skill view, or one linked file when `file` is given.

post.summary: Writes `skills.disabled` (and `skills.platform_disabled.webui` when present) in config.yaml.
`section` names the file (memory, user, soul); the legacy `target` alias is accepted.
Restart the Hermes gateway for the active profile (operator only).
Stop the server process (operator only).
`{enabled}` toggles, `{delete: true}` removes, `{url|command, ...}` adds or updates the server in config.yaml.

get.summary: Cached status; `POST` runs the check. Git source installs can update from completed releases (stable) or origin/main (experimental); direct global npm installs can update to completed stable npm releases.

Server-owned update operation history for the authenticated owner and active profile. A Web tab passes its tab_id and loaded_build so the server compares that build and keeps its tab-scoped refresh notice.

post.summary: Bounded browser diagnostics; only whitelisted scalar fields are logged.
Read eligible context sources for the editor execution store.
Start a manual run in the sidecar; answers immediately with `status: running` (or `already_running`).

get.summary: Each active-profile job's latest completion after `since` (Unix seconds), newest first. Not a run archive.

post.summary: Spawn (or reuse) the embedded PTY shell for a session workspace (local origin when auth is off).

get.summary: Redirect the browser to the configured OIDC provider (302, `Cache-Control: no-store`).

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Safe path-absolute return target after login.

get.summary: Authorization-code callback: verifies the id_token, sets the session cookie, and redirects to `next` (or the native app).

parameters.name: error
parameters.description: Provider error code (yields 401 or a native failure redirect).

401.description: Provider error or claim policy rejection.

get.summary: Live agent-turn relay (SSE). Journal-backed frames carry `id: <stream_id>:<seq>`; resume with `after_event_id`, `after_seq`, or `Last-Event-ID`.

parameters.name: replay
parameters.description: `1` replays the journal from the start.

404.description: No live stream and no journal.

get.summary: Persistent per-session channel (`initial`, `server_turn_started`, `session-updated`, `bg_task_complete`).

parameters.name: known_count
parameters.description: Last message count the tab rendered; a higher persisted count triggers `session-updated`.

get.summary: Global session-list invalidation stream (`sessions_changed`).

parameters.name: gateway
parameters.description: `1` merges the gateway feed with a `stream` discriminator and an initial `gateway_status` frame.

get.summary: Per-session run-journal relay with `Last-Event-ID` resume and `session_snapshot` fallback.

parameters.name: after_event_id
parameters.description: Resume cursor when the header is unavailable.

get.summary: Approval prompt stream (`initial` then `approval`).
Clarify prompt stream (`initial` then `clarify`).
Raw bytes of a workspace file or a session upload.

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session whose workspace anchors the path.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: `1` serves HTML inline under a CSP sandbox.

200.description: File bytes with ETag and byte-range support.

206.description: Partial content for a satisfiable Range header.

404.description: Path outside the workspace or missing.

get.summary: Local media referenced by the chat (allow-listed roots, MEDIA: tokens, or an immutable snapshot).

parameters.name: session_id
parameters.description: Session whose assistant messages may grant the path.

parameters.name: inline
parameters.description: `1` allows inline audio, video, PDF, and sandboxed HTML.

parameters.name: snap
parameters.description: SHA-256 digest of a message-level snapshot bound to the path.

403.description: Path not in an allowed location.

get.summary: ZIP of a workspace folder (symlinks escaping the workspace are skipped).
